title: 第911章 大夏皇朝来人第910章 是你
content_zh:
王玄戾这时反应过来，已经为时晚矣，面对袭掠至近前的剑芒，已经精疲力尽的他无力躲避，只得拼尽全力，将剩余的元力全部倾泻而出，催动玄王盾御。
尽管王玄戾这一道防御武技威力不凡，但刚刚数百道灭世神拳连绵不断的狂轰滥炸，已经让他身负重伤，丹田之中储存的元力也近乎见底。
此时此刻，面对威力远强于灭世神拳的一剑斩天，王玄戾自然再无丝毫抵抗的余地。
轰！
伴随着一声震天动地的巨响，王玄戾面前的墨青色盾牌支离破碎，化作一道道流光飞溅四处。
剑芒的威力，仅仅只被抵消了一半不到，结结实实正面命中他的身躯，瞬间席卷起凌厉的元力风暴。
“不，我不能死！
啊啊啊！”
王玄戾发出一声声凄厉的惨叫，但任凭他拼尽全力，也根本无法逃脱出元力风暴的桎梏，只能承受着万千道杀意腾腾的剑威，不断穿透、撕裂自己的身体。
片刻后，元力风暴平息下来，王玄戾已然被斩杀为漫天血雾，只剩下一枚空间戒指，漂浮在血雾之间。
苏辰信手一挥，将王玄戾的空间戒指隔空抓到手中，旋即内心才稍稍放松些许。
包括始作俑者王玄戾在内，王家所有武者，都已经被他斩杀殆尽。
这样一来，中州范围内，知道雪儿天凰绝阴体秘密的人全部清除得干干净净，他们两人的安全，至少得到暂时的保证了。
“雪儿，出来吧。”
苏辰心念一动，直接将洛雪儿从天机宝玉空间内召唤出来。
洛雪儿还没有反应过来发生了什么，便瞬间从天机宝玉空间中来到外界，不由满脸惊奇：“少爷，这个天机宝玉，究竟是你从何处得到的宝物？实在是太神奇了！”
作为曾经的青州四大极品妖孽，绝情谷寄予厚望的圣女，洛雪儿也曾见识过不少空间宝物。
大到秘境之中的前辈传承，小到其他顶级势力天骄的保命底牌，但不论是哪一种，与苏辰的天机宝玉相比，都显得黯然失色。
内部拥有无限大的空间，瞬息间就可以将人传送进来或者召唤出去，不需要任何蓄力。
更重要的是，只要进入这个空间内，几乎就是绝对安全的，即便是能撕裂空间的武帝强者，都奈何不了他们分毫。

苏辰淡淡一笑：“这个宝物，是我母亲当初留给我的，若是没有这枚天机宝玉，我恐怕早就已经死了不知多少次，断不可能一路走到今天。”
洛雪儿瞬间陷入缄默，不再多问。
关于少爷的母亲，她同样一无所知，也知道这绝不是自己应该问的问题。
沉默了一阵，洛雪儿突然察觉到什么，眼中再次划过一丝异彩。
她感受到了王玄戾及王家武者们的气息，但却不见一道人影，心中顿时产生一丝激动，试探性问道：“少爷，王家哪些人……”
“都已经被我干掉了。”
苏辰道。
洛雪儿这才如释重负长舒一口气，道：“自从离开九鸾岛以来，我就一直被王家人追杀得东奔西走，甚至被逼入黑雾深渊之中，如今少爷终于帮我报仇雪恨，我们也总算是不必为王家的报复而日夜悬心了！”
苏辰凝声道：“话虽如此，但我们也不能放松警惕，虽然我刚刚以最快速度杀死了王家其他人，并且对付王玄戾时也是将其全程压制，但也无法确定他们有没有抓住机会进行传讯，还是尽快离开此地，免得王家人再追杀过来徒增变数，等随罗兄到了大夏皇朝，我们的安全才算是真正暂时得到保证。”
“嗯嗯，那咱们赶紧走吧。”
content_en:
Wang Xuanli reacted at this time, but it was already too late. Faced with the approaching sword light, he was exhausted and unable to dodge. He had to use all his strength to pour out all the remaining energy to activate King Xuan's shield.
Although Wang Xuanli's defensive martial arts was extremely powerful, the continuous and indiscriminate bombardment of hundreds of world-destroying divine fists had left him seriously injured, and the energy stored in his dantian was almost at its bottom.
At this moment, facing a sword that was far more powerful than the World-Destroying Divine Fist, Wang Xuanru naturally had no room for resistance.
boom!
With a loud noise that shook the earth, the dark blue shield in front of Wang Xuanli was shattered into pieces and turned into streaks of light splashing everywhere.
The power of the sword light was only offset by less than half, and it hit his body head-on, instantly sweeping up a fierce storm of Yuanli.
"No, I can't die!
Ahhhh! "
Wang Xuanli let out shrill screams, but no matter how hard he tried, he could not escape the shackles of the Yuanli Storm. He could only bear the power of thousands of murderous swords, constantly penetrating and tearing his body.
After a while, the Yuanli storm subsided, and Wang Xuanli was killed into blood mist that filled the sky. Only a space ring was left, floating in the blood mist.
Su Chen waved his hand and grabbed Wang Xuanli's space ring from the air, and immediately felt a little relaxed.
Including the instigator Wang Xuanru, all the warriors of the Wang family have been killed by him.
In this way, all those who knew the secret of Xue'er's Tianhuang Jueyin body within Zhongzhou were completely eliminated, and the safety of the two of them was at least temporarily guaranteed.
"Xue'er, come out."
With a thought in his mind, Su Chen summoned Luo Xueer directly from the Tianji Baoyu space.
Before Luo Xue'er could react to what happened, she instantly came from the Tianji Baoyu space to the outside world. She couldn't help but be surprised: "Master, where did you get this Tianji Baoyu? It's really amazing!"
As one of the four top monsters in Qingzhou and a saint who had high hopes in the Jueqing Valley, Luo Xueer had also seen many space treasures.
It ranges from the inheritance of the predecessors in the secret realm to the life-saving trump card of other top powers' geniuses, but no matter which one it is, it pales in comparison to Su Chen's secret gem.
There is an infinite space inside, and people can be teleported in or summoned out in an instant without any need to accumulate energy.
More importantly, as long as you enter this space, it is almost absolutely safe. Even the powerful Martial Emperor who can tear apart the space cannot do anything to them.
Su Chen smiled faintly: "This treasure was left to me by my mother. Without this secret gem, I would have died countless times, and I would never have been able to make it all the way to where I am today."
Luo Xueer fell silent for a moment and asked no more questions.
She also knew nothing about the young master's mother, and knew that this was definitely not a question she should ask.
After a while of silence, Luo Xueer suddenly noticed something, and a glimmer of light flashed through her eyes again.
She felt the aura of Wang Xuanru and the warriors of the Wang family, but there was no one there. She suddenly felt a little excited in her heart, and asked tentatively: "Master, who are the Wang family members..."
"I've already killed them all."
Su Chen said.
Luo Xueer breathed a sigh of relief and said: "Since I left Jiuluan Island, I have been chased here and there by the Wang family, and even forced into the abyss of black mist. Now that the young master has finally helped me avenge my hatred, we finally don't have to worry about the Wang family's revenge day and night!"
Su Chen said solemnly: "Having said that, we can't let down our guard. Although I just killed other members of the Wang family as quickly as possible, and suppressed Wang Xuanru all the way, I still can't be sure whether they seized the opportunity to conduct interrogations or left here as soon as possible., lest the Wang family come after us again and add more variables, our safety will be truly temporarily guaranteed when we follow Brother Luo to the Great Xia Dynasty. "
"Yeah, let's go quickly. "
